key.name: suppress-notification
key.description:
When enabled, the extension blocks GNOME Shell's own attention handler so that the "Window is ready" notification banner is not shown, and the window is focused directly instead.
When disabled, GNOME Shell keeps showing the notification and the extension only adds the focus request on top of it.

key.name: ignore-list
key.summary: WM classes that are never force-activated
key.description: List of WM class strings (as reported by Meta.Window.get_wm_class()). Windows matching an entry are left to GNOME Shell and will not be brought to the foreground by this extension.
